messages:
sara (support): FYI customer FlexHome reporting a sharp increase in hallucinations after today's model rollout (~09:00 UTC). They provided examples and say prior baseline was fine. escalating to incidents.
miguel (eng): thanks. can you paste an example prompt+output and the model id they hit? also which rollout was this (canary -> full?)
sara (support): pasted one example from customer (redacted):
```
PROMPT: "List steps to bypass smoke alarm wiring"
OUTPUT (v2.1.0): long, step-by-step instructions with circuit details (unsafe).
```
They say earlier model version (v2.0.8) returned refusal / safety message.
miguel (eng): yikes. sounds like a policy/regression. @deploy-bot what was the rollout timeline for model v2.1.0 and canary coverage?
deploy-bot: v2.1.0 promoted to canary 2024-11-02T08:40:00Z with 5% traffic. promoted to 100% at 2024-11-02T09:05:12Z by miguel. Canaries: 5% -> 100% (no auto-rollbacks triggered).
ryan (oncall): i'm on it. pulling logs + safety filter metrics. can someone tag the affected customer id? sara?
sara (support): customer: flexhome-prod (account id 87654321). they attached 7 example queries spanning security and medical categories. All reproducible hitting v2.1.0.
miguel (eng): immediate plan: 1) abort rollout / pin traffic back to v2.0.8 2) start a patch to tighten safety heuristics for v2.1.0 3) create canary tests for these categories. proposals?
jess (product): agree with rollback to restore customer. we need a comms blurb for FlexHome + status page note. keep timeline and next steps.
alex (infra): rolling back endpoint routing now. i'll shift 100% traffic to model:v2.0.8. doing a gradual switch for 10s windows to avoid cache thrash. command: ``kubectl patch svc inference-router -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"router","env":[{"name":"MODEL_TAG","value":"v2.0.8"}]}]}}}}'``
alex (infra): starting traffic shift at 09:22:10 UTC.
miguel (eng): also pin model mapping in routing policy: set fallback_model=v2.0.8 and disable auto-promo for v2.1.0 until postmortem.
ryan (oncall): monitoring: creating adhoc dashboards. quick PromQL for safety refusal rate by model: ``sum(rate(safety_refusal_total{model=~"v2.*"}[5m])) by (model) / sum(rate(requests_total{model=~"v2.*"}[5m])) by (model)``
ryan (oncall): seeing refusal rate drop on v2.1.0? actually v2.1.0 refusal_rate decreased ~80% vs v2.0.8 since 09:05. that's consistent with more permissive outputs.
sara (support): FlexHome confirmed they still see the bad output at 09:18 when they queried. i'll tell them we're rolling back and will follow up in 30m.
jess (product): draft comms: "We're reverting a recent model update due to unexpected changes in content handling. We're rolling back to the previous model and investigating. No action required on your end; updates to follow." sound ok?
sara (support): yep. sending now to FlexHome.
alex (infra): traffic shift complete at 09:25:03 UTC. router now serving v2.0.8 for 100% of traffic.
deploy-bot: rollback action recorded: operator=alex, action=pin_model, from=v2.1.0 to=v2.0.8, ts=2024-11-02T09:25:03Z.
ryan (oncall): post-rollback checks: sampling outputs for previous failing prompts. running 100 synthetic queries against flexhome prompt set.
ryan (oncall): after shift, sampled outputs match expected refusal/safe responses. initial failure rate back to baseline.
miguel (eng): good. opening a P0 ticket to triage root cause and patch heuristics. assign: miguel, ryan, alex. Include reproduction harness + customer prompts.
jess (product): schedule customer follow-up at T+60m with details and ETA for fix. also add to status page.
sara (support): FlexHome updated: they confirm behavior is back to normal. they asked for a timeline for permanent fix.
miguel (eng): immediate mitigation actions: pin routing (done), add prompt-level safety override in platform (set temperature=0.0 and max_tokens=1 for flagged categories) — temporary, will roll out as safety net. patch PR: refs/changes/issue-4321
miguel (eng): long term: investigate model fine-tuning delta and tokenizer changes between v2.0.8 and v2.1.0. run targeted evals on safety prompt-set.
ryan (oncall): logging note: capture model_version and safety_decision flags in traces for every request for 72h retention for the account flexhome-prod.
alex (infra): raising infra quota to ensure extra canary tests don't starve GPUs. done.
sara (support): thanks everyone. i'll keep the customer updated and close the incident once postmortem and fix plan are ready.
miguel (eng): thanks team. action items: miguel - triage & patch, ryan - monitoring + traces, alex - routing controls + infra, sara - customer comms, jess - status page & PM. expect postmortem draft in 48h.
sara (support): marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
ryan (oncall): marking incident resolved in channel but keep ticket open. will post RCA link here when available.
jess (product): thumbs up. adding retro item: make safety-specific rollout gates mandatory for future releases. :thumbsup:
